name: 雨街 · 湿透的丝袜
description: 雨中街头行走，水手服湿透贴身（wet clothes = 2 档），黑丝在 socks 里随机。
pose_tags: walking, expressionless, looking ahead, parted lips, serafuku, loafers, wet clothes, rainy street, soaked
pose_nl: she walks along the rainy street in a soaked serafuku. the wet tights cling to her legs and shine. rain runs off the edge of her skirt and her loafers splash in the puddles.
